votes.motion: Issue a negative determination for the request for determination at 48 Oak Ridge Road (Bill Terrell).
votes.quote: td moved for a negative determination. kj seconded and the commission voted unanimously.

votes.motion: Continue the Nancy Sullivan hearing at 28 Birch Island Way to May 17.
votes.quote: kj moved to continue to the 17th of may. cl seconded and the commission approved unanimously.

votes.motion: Issue a negative determination for the Paul Morin request at 894 Northfield Road.
votes.quote: kj moved to issue a negative determination. td seconded and the commission voted unanimously.

votes.motion: Continue the Jeffry Viviano amendment hearing at 338 Sunset Lane to May 17th.
votes.quote: jr moved to continue to may 17th. td seconded and the commission voted unanimously.

votes.motion: Approve the Jonathan Boyd Notice of Intent at 121 Peninsula Drive, starting with zone 5 with erosion protection.
votes.quote: motion to approve staring with zone 5 with erosion protection. by kj with a second by td and a unanimous vote to approve.

votes.motion: Accept the amendment to the previously approved driveway access at 667 Reservoir Road (Paul Gougen).
votes.quote: kj moved to accept the amendment. cl seconded and the commission voted to unanimously approve.

votes.motion: Approve an Order of Conditions for Gougen Construction at 675 Reservoir Road.
votes.quote: kj moved to approve an order of conditions. cl seconded and the commission voted unanimously.

votes.motion: Refer the 183 Hemlock Dr wall construction in a flood plain to DEP.
votes.quote: referred to dep for the wall construction in a flood plain by motion of kj and a second by cl.

votes.motion: Approve the forest stewardship plans presented by Gary Gouldrup.
